violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: BROWN RICE AT 120F IN HOT TABLE (LEFT).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REHEATED FOODS TO 192F DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SALAD MIX AT 56F, CORN AT 57F ON COLD TABLE (RIGHT).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food (TCS) shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO TRANSFER FOODS TO REFRIGERATOR OR FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F. PLEASE ENSURE FOODS ARE COOLED TO 41F OR BELOW BEFORE PLACING ON COLD SERVICE LINE.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SALAD MIX AT 48- 54F ON COLD SERVICE TABLE; SALAD MIX AT 44F IN DELFIELD 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED SALAD TO OTHER REFRIGERATORS FOR RAPID COOLING DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: FISH PATTIES AT 119- 129F IN METRO C200 HOT HOLDING CABINET.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REHEAT FISH PATTIES TO 165F BEFORE RETURNING TO HOT HOLDING.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following hot holding unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain hot foods at or above 135F: METRO C200 HOT HOLDING UNIT AT THERMOSTAT AT 210F, INTERNAL THERMOMETER AT 180F, FOODS NOT ABLE TO MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES OF 135F OR ABOVE.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or above 135F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE REPAIR AND EMAIL EHS ONCE UNTIL HAS BEEN REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN PROPER HOT HOLDING TEMPERATURES OF 135F OR ABOVE.
